mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 3%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy with loose monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals a tight labor market with strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is also declining, it signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 consecutive quarters and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 is negative for 2 consecutive quarters and INDPRO is declining and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
